# Embedded SQLite engine

`sql-wasm-inline.js` is the unmodified `dist/sql-wasm-inline.js` from the npm release `sql.js@1.15.2`. The distribution embeds SQLite WebAssembly, so the workbench can run from an unpacked folder without external requests. Its MIT license and the included notices are in `sqljs-LICENSE.txt`.
